title: Meridian Transit opens the Harbor Line
body: The Harbor Line opened to passengers on 14 March 2025, connecting the old docks to the university district. The line has 11 stations and cost 2.3 billion crowns to build. It is operated by the Meridian Transit Authority, and its chief engineer was Ilse Varga. Fares and the official ridership forecast are published on the project's detail page.

title: Kestrel Robotics recalls K-9 warehouse robot
body: Kestrel Robotics has recalled 4,200 units of its K-9 warehouse robot after a fault was found in battery controller firmware version 2.1.4. Chief executive Tomas Brandl said the fault could cause units to shut down under heavy load. Customers will receive firmware version 2.1.6, which fixes the problem.

title: Northgate Bank warns customers of phishing wave
body: Northgate Bank says about 1,900 customers were targeted by a phishing campaign using the fake domain northgate-secure-login. The bank's chief information security officer, Priya Raman, said the emails copied the bank's branding closely. Northgate has reimbursed affected customers a total of 310,000 crowns.

title: Avalen University launches quantum computing lab
body: Avalen University has opened a quantum computing lab funded by a 45 million crown grant from the Holt Foundation. The lab is directed by Dr. Samuel Okafor and houses a 127-qubit device named Lantern. The university says the lab will be open to outside researchers from next year.

title: Solace Health fined over patient data breach
body: Solace Health exposed 62,000 patient records because of a misconfigured storage bucket. The exposure was discovered by security researcher Mina Castellanos, who reported it to the company. The Data Protection Board has fined Solace Health 1.2 million crowns.

title: Tidewater Energy to build offshore wind farm at Cape Lorn
body: Tidewater Energy will build an offshore wind farm at Cape Lorn with 72 turbines and a total capacity of 864 MW. Construction will be carried out by the contractor Brightwind Marine, and the farm is due to be completed in 2027.

title: City council approves annual budget
body: The Avalen city council has approved a budget of 5.8 billion crowns by a vote of 9-4. Mayor Elena Marchetti said that 18 percent of the budget is allocated to transit. Opponents argued the plan spends too little on housing.

title: Kestrel Robotics acquires Pallet Logic
body: Kestrel Robotics has acquired the logistics software company Pallet Logic for 140 million crowns. Pallet Logic was founded in 2016 by Rana Idris and has 85 employees. Kestrel said the Pallet Logic team will stay in its current offices.

title: Harbor Line ridership falls short in first quarter
body: The Harbor Line averaged 71,000 daily riders in its first quarter, below the forecast published when the line opened. The busiest station was Customs Quay. Meridian Transit Authority said ridership usually grows in a line's second year.

title: Avalen Marathon: Mengistu and Lindqvist win
body: Dawit Mengistu won the men's race at the Avalen Marathon in 2:07:41. Sofia Lindqvist won the women's race in 2:24:09. Organisers said 18,500 runners finished the course.

title: Orchid Labs releases open-source model Fennel-2
body: Orchid Labs has released Fennel-2, an open-source language model with 9 billion parameters, under the Apache 2.0 licence. The project's lead researcher is Dr. Hana Kobayashi, who previously worked at Avalen University's quantum computing lab.

title: Port strike ends after wage deal
body: A strike at the Port of Avalen has ended after 12 days. The union, Dockworkers Local 41, accepted a wage rise of 6.5 percent over two years. Shipping companies said it will take about a week to clear the backlog.

title: Lumen Museum reopens after renovation
body:
The Lumen Museum reopened on 2 June 2025 after a three-year renovation that cost 95 million crowns. Director Clara Voss said the new galleries double the exhibition space.

title: Work begins on Riverside stormwater tunnel
body: Work has begun on the Riverside stormwater tunnel, which will be 6.4 km long and cost 780 million crowns. It is due to be completed in 2028. Technical details, including the tunnel's flow capacity, are on the project's detail page.
